description: A domain or subdomain that sends through Mailset while its mail is received elsewhere: DKIM and bounce CNAMEs into Mailset's zone, and an MX to Mailset once replies to it come to Mailset. Applied with host for a subdomain such as news.example.com. The bounce host is mail.<name>, or bounces.<name> when mail.<name> holds something else: one of bouncemail or bouncebounces is applied, never both.
variableDescription: %label%: the domain's own name inside Mailset's zone, 24 lowercase hex characters, under which its DKIM keys and bounce host live
